description: Retirement and reuse among packed long values (Lv rows 10..15 hold six 100-byte OLE values side by side): delete row 12; insert a new 100-byte value (row 20); delete row 5 (a 9000-byte chain); insert a new 9000-byte value (row 22). Asks whether neighbouring values stay unchanged and whether retired space is reused. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it.
